title: A calmer Scorecard and one consistent look
items: The Scorecard now uses the same section labels and titled panels as Rankings, with duplicate numbers and scattered footnotes folded into one "How to read this record" panel.
The @timurknowsball comparison left the Scorecard; it stays on the home board.
Rankings now run Power Rating, then the AP Top 25, then the TimurKnowsBall Ballot.
Every tab uses one typeface, one tighter text-size scale and the shared colour palette.
